types.description: ABB S202M-C16 miniature circuit breaker / 2 poles / C characteristic / 16 A / Icn 10 kA at 400 V AC

document.title: ABB System pro M compact — Technical catalogue

modelingNotes: Exact order 2CDS272001R0164 is S 202 M-C 16: two protected poles, C characteristic, rated current 16 A; selection table 2/38.

S200-family S202 diagram 11/2 shows numeric terminals 1-2 and 3-4, open contacts and mechanical ganging. No phase or neutral assignment is inferred. Supply direction is optional per 2/20; roles are therefore bidirectional power.

IEC/EN 60898-1: two-pole rated operational voltage 400 V AC, 50/60 Hz, Icn 10 kA, C-curve reference temperature 30 degrees C. IEC/EN 60947-2: Ue 440 V AC, Icu 15 kA, Ics 11.2 kA for rated currents up to 40 A, C-curve reference temperature 55 degrees C (2/16). Voltage and interrupting capacities are documented with conditions, not assigned supply values.

Twin conductor/busbar entries are parts of each numbered cylinder-lift terminal, modeled as a shared connection point rather than invented separately numbered terminals. Table 2/20 lists 35 mm2 solid/stranded, 25 mm2 flexible and 10 mm2 busbar capacity top/bottom.

Only the base breaker is included. Auxiliary contacts, signal contacts, releases and motor operators are combination accessories (2/20), not supplied connection inventory. No PE, shield, communication or separate return terminal is shown.

Open is the catalogue drawing state, not a prediction of installed handle position. Contact functions and ganged_with metadata create no permanent continuity. Terminal use is application-dependent; no universally required terminal is asserted. Protection dynamics and coordination are outside this connectivity model.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four numbered electrical connection points of the base two-pole breaker: 1, 2, 3, 4. Twin wire/busbar entries share each numbered terminal. No separately purchased accessory contacts or external bonding connections are included.
